slides.body:
Green plants convert light energy into chemical energy.

Photosynthesis occurs through absorption, splitting, and fixation.

slides.title: Photosynthesis Overview
slides.body: Plants capture sunlight energy using a pigment called chlorophyll.
bullet_points: Plants absorb sunlight through their leaves, converting it into usable chemical energy.
This process allows plants to grow and produce oxygen during photosynthesis.
slides.speaker_notes: Key concept: Plants utilize sunlight energy conversion for growth and oxygen production.

slides.title: The Role of Chloroplasts in Photosynthesis
slides.body: Plants capture sunlight energy using a pigment called chlorophyll.
bullet_points: Plants convert light energy into chemical energy using chloroplasts.
Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, which absorbs red and blue wavelengths of light.

slides.title: Photosynthesis Overview
slides.body: Plants capture sunlight energy using chloroplasts, converting it into chemical energy.
bullet_points: Plants absorb sunlight through their chloroplasts.
Chloroplasts contain pigments like chlorophyll, which absorb light energy.

slides.title: The Importance of Photosynthesis
slides.body: Plants form food, animals eat them; regulates climate. Photosynthesis produces glucose, oxygen. Key environmental factors limit efficiency.
bullet_points: Plants absorb sunlight through their chloroplasts.
Sunlight energy captured by chlorophyll drives photosynthesis.
Oxygen produced during photosynthesis helps plants breathe.
Carbon dioxide absorbed also supports plant growth.
